decision.reason: The user asked to drive the comic work merged in #244 (isekai casting from the archetype guide, tiled comic layouts, the misread review, adventure settings with the office check, and a second independent draft) to a released version, and to finish the release autonomously once #244 merged. The comic changes were evaluated in the separate comicbench project; that benchmark is not one of this contract's stages. The retained prbench inputs needed for calibration and admission are not available on the release machine, so the CI-tested candidate is released without a benchmark round. No evaluation result or performance gain is claimed.
